newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ monetary conditions index down in April - BTNZ.
newsitem.headline: NZ monetary conditions index down in April - BTNZ.

text.p: Bankers Trust New Zealand said on Monday its Monetary Conditions Index fell to an average of 128 in April from 129 in March and against 124 assumed by the RBNZ in its March projections.
In early May the index fell to 121.5 after conditions eased on comments made by Reserve Bank Governor Don Brash.
The comments meant the market could rule out any tightening in its June statement, BT said.
"We think the RBNZ will go further and ease (or validate an easing) from levels assumed in its March projections," it said.
But the 2.2 percent increase in March quarter house prices plus quarterly jobs data on Tuesday and March quarter wages data will determine how aggressively the RBNZ eases, BT said.
